papers.summary: This study investigates mineral trapping and geochemical evolution during and after 50 years of CO2 injection into the UK Bunter Sandstone Formation by comparing reactive-transport predictions from two different simulators (CMG and TOUGHREACT) over a 3,000-year period.

papers.authors: Shahram Asgari
papers.summary: This paper compiles 17 bioleaching studies involving various industrial wastes, organisms, and recovery runs, and describes them using a single physical model named BioLixa, which links organism acid production, solution charge balance, and residue alkalinity to compute metal release, precipitation, and pH.

papers.summary: This thesis investigates a hybrid framework combining MARUS-simulated maneuvering data, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), and Large Language Model (LLM)-guided symbolic discovery to estimate ship maneuvering hydrodynamic derivatives for autonomous vessels, aiming to improve robustness, data efficiency, and interpretability compared to conventional methods.
